name: manual_2e1615
claim: Do not call a git scrub or surgery operation complete without naming its verified scope: current tree, commit metadata, PR-unique blob range, and repository-wide all-ref blob history are separate gates with separate evidence.

decisions.notes: PR258 had clean current-tree and PR-unique range evidence while inherited main history still had separate all-ref hits. The correct closeout language reports the verified branch scope and keeps repo-wide expunge as a distinct follow-up unless it is actually run and passes.
